description: The Outlook Race range for one coin: the simulated price range from today's price for 1, 3 and 6 months and 1, 2 and 5 years (bad case = 5th percentile, middle, great case = 95th) and the share of simulated paths that end below today's price. Quote the range, never a single target. status=no_simulation when the coin's price history cannot be proven to be this coin's. Scenario simulations, not a forecast. No key. From EventTrader's crypto dashboards (cymetica.com/crypto). Every number carries its source and time; a number that failed a plausibility check is withheld, never guessed. Places no orders, moves no funds. Not financial advice.
